title: Stromal innervation is prognostic in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer and predicted by a distinct microenvironmental transcriptomic signature.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
journalName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
snippet: Peripheral nerves are increasingly recognized as active components of the tumor microenvironment (TME). Yet, their role in non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) and response to Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) remains poorly defined.
